expectedCards.front: Il museo è aperto alle sette?
expectedCards.back: Is the museum open at seven?

note: Same shape as vado-al-bar: Italian in word tiles, English under 'Nicely done. Meaning:'. The tiles carry no punctuation while the meaning is interrogative — the harness strips punctuation before comparing, so a front with or without the question mark both match. Diacritic in 'è' is NOT folded, so dropping it counts as wrong.
